# Katthapaññattivāra (Pvr 2.1)

**ID:** Pvr 2.1
**Section:** Parivāra (pvr)
**Collection:** Vinaya
**Title (Pali):** Katthapaññattivāra
**tipitaka.org (CST):** https://tipitaka.org/romn/cscd/vin02m4.mul0.xml

## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

The *Katthapaññattivāra* (Pvr 2.1) is a text of the *Parivāra*, the concluding section of the Pali Vinaya Piṭaka. Titled in English as "Questions and answers on the nuns’ Monastic Code and its analysis," the text systematic provides an analysis of the origins and promulgation settings of each Vinaya rule for Buddhist nuns (*bhikkhunī*s). It serves as a counterpart to the monks' *Katthapaññattivāra* (Pvr 1.1) and is associated with it as well as with the *Upālisutta* (AN 10.31). The text has been translated into English by Bhikkhu Brahmali.

Automated analysis by DharmaNexus documents extensive internal text reuse across the Pali Canon, sharing thousands of matching passages with related Vinaya literature [DharmaNexus]. Its most substantial textual overlaps occur with the monks' *Katthapaññattivāra* (Pvr 1.1; 8,433 matches, sharing particularly §2.6–19.1 with §61.6–78.1), another *Katthapaññattivāra* chapter (Pvr 1.9), the *Pārājikakaṇḍa* of the Parivāra (Pvr 2.9), the *Bhikkhunī Pātimokkha*, and Vinaya commentaries including the *Pārājikakaṇḍa-aṭṭhakathā* and *Parivāra-aṭṭhakathā* [DharmaNexus]. In cross-language matching, DharmaNexus aligns passages of the text with non-Pali Vinaya materials, including the Tibetan translation of the *Bhikṣuṇīvinayavibhaṅga* (D0005) and *Bhikṣuṇīprātimokṣasūtra* (D0004), the *Vinayasūtra* (D4117) and its commentaries, and Sanskrit Vinaya texts such as the *Pravāraṇāvastu* and *Prātimokṣasūtra* [DharmaNexus].

*No discussion of this text was found in the reference-literature corpus; the overview relies on catalog and DharmaNexus data.*
